feature: Summary-first log access and on-demand bounded queries
expected: A valid owned growing log can be identified safely and inspected without routinely delivering its complete content.
observed: The prior native attempt stopped when identity binding applied a 2 MB whole-file cap to a valid 2.5 MB log. The corrected feature binds only a bounded UTF-8 header and retained file identity, while separate summary/query budgets govern inspection. Focused offline checks pass; native proof was not rerun.

proposed_findings.finding: Separate file identity, whole-log evidence integrity, bounded operator/model-facing projections, and native model context.
proposed_findings.disposition: targeted improvement implemented and offline verified; native context and full-history evidence requirements explicitly unchanged.

proposed_findings.finding: Search permitted content before clipping; pagination must retain every undispatched record with its exact pre-read cursor state.
proposed_findings.disposition: Focused regressions cover early literals, scan and response boundaries, oversized records, and independent CLI invocations.

duplicate_check.method: Installed memory lexical search for log header summary cursor plus bounded comparison with existing notes
duplicate_check.outcome: No matching prior log/cursor finding identified; historical automatic-capture note is a different topic.
